title: Cosmological consequences of a dynamical dark matter in the light of DESI DR2 measurements
efc_relevance: A dynamical-dark-matter model provides a competing explanation for a late transition and lower S8 without EFC's entropic-flow mechanism. The strongest CMB+DESI+DESY5 combination finds w_DM,0 = -0.060^{+0.013}_{-0.028}, a_t = 0.41^{+0.088}_{-0.13}, S8 = 0.783^{+0.013}_{-0.020}, and unchanged H0; the transition is not the same observable as EFC's P1 lensing crossover.
ledger_action: Add to External Research Ledger under a new alternative-dark-matter competitor cluster; cross-reference P4 as qualitative S8 overlap and P7 as a negative constraint because H0 remains unchanged. Do not mark P1 as hit: a_t is a model transition scale, not a measured Sigma_eff sign change at z ~ 0.44; do not add this third-party paper to the EFC evidence register.
